label_contract.conflict_amplifying: 0..1 likelihood that the wording invites escalation or adversarial exchange
label_contract.constructive_disagreement: boolean disagreement that supplies reasons, evidence, or a concrete correction without attack
label_contract.counterspeech: boolean response that challenges hostility, abuse, or harmful claims
label_contract.instruction_like_text: boolean text that directs an annotator, model, system, or reviewer to follow an instruction or emit specified wording
label_contract.confidence: 0..1 confidence based only on the supplied text

evidence_scope.calibration_use: Train and validation comments may calibrate a local text scorer.
evidence_scope.audit_use: Test comments are a frozen semantic audit set and may not train or tune the scorer.
evidence_scope.outcome_blinding: No later thread outcome is included in an annotation prompt.
evidence_scope.claim: Measurement calibration only; model labels are not ground truth or causal evidence.
